subject: Reinstate small sandbox allocation to finish PartnerPilot POC
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@partnerpilot.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC credits expired — short request to finish integration

Hi Olga,

We're right near the finish line on the PartnerPilot integration but our sandbox credits expired last night and the CI smoke tests are blocked. Can Redwood do a small, one-time top-up so we can complete the final integration and smoke test before we present to our engineering leadership next week?

What we need: ~250k tokens (roughly a 2-week extension for our workload) or a $200 credit — whichever is simpler from your side. We're happy to sign a short mutual action plan committing to a demo date and a quick post-PO procurement if the POC is successful.

I've attached a screenshot of current usage and the brief scope of what's left (PartnerPilot_POC_scope.pdf).

Appreciate any help — this POC is time-sensitive for our product launch.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations
PartnerPilot
(samira@partnerpilot.ai)

Attachment: usage_screenshot.png
Attachment: PartnerPilot_POC_scope.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@partnerpilot.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC credits expired — short request to finish integration

Hi Samira — thank you for the clear note and the scope doc.

Short answer: we can usually offer a one-off sandbox top-up for cases like this. I don't have unilateral authority to issue credits for deals, so I've looped in Marcus (sales lead) and Karthik (pricing/finance) to confirm amounts and any procurement asks.

Proposal (pending internal approval):
- One-time 250k token top-up, expiring in 14 days from issuance
- If POC converts to paid within 30 days, we will credit back the amount against the first invoice (simple offset)

If Marcus/Karthik approve, I can push the credit and send a short approval note that you can keep for your procurement/audit team. Can you confirm the demo date or milestone we should tie the extension to?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

- Mark the credit as expiring 14 days after issuance and record the deal_id (PP-2025-09) in the approval note for finance/audit.

Karthik, over to you.

Hi Samira — good news. We approved a one-time 250k-token sandbox top-up for PartnerPilot. Details below and attached official note for your records.

What we pushed:
- 250,000 token credit added to PartnerPilot sandbox (non-renewing)
- Expires 14 days after issuance: credit will auto-expire at 23:59 UTC on 2025-06-02
- If PartnerPilot signs within 30 days, we'll offset the credited amount against the first invoice (referenced to deal_id PP-2025-09)

Mutual action plan (please confirm by reply):
- Redwood to issue credit: completed
- PartnerPilot to complete CI run and 30-minute integration demo to Engineering Lead: target 2025-05-28
- PartnerPilot to confirm success in this thread or via the attached signed note

I've attached the approval note (approved_credit_note.pdf) which includes the internal approval trail and deal id for your procurement/audit. Marcus is CC'd.

If the target demo date needs to move, tell me and we'll adjust expectations; the credit expiry is fixed but we'll work reasonably with timing.

Best,
